quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 collective results briefing: CFO Chen Zhenhua said data-center products are priced above telecom products and carry higher margins, so the rising data-center share, together with scale effects, is lifting overall price level and gross margin; main customers pay normally and receivable turnover is improving. Chairman Zhang Xingang said data-center sales have become an important revenue source as AI drives laser-chip demand, completing the shift to a 'telecom plus datacom' supplier.
